question: What will the first reported revenues after September 2026 be for the following companies? (Meta)

calls.reasoning: Meta guided Q3 2026 revenue to $61-64B (~1% FX headwind). Over Q4'24-Q2'26 actual revenue landed between -$0.2B and +$2.0B versus the top of guidance (mean about +$0.6B); Q1'26 ($56.3B vs 53.5-56.5) and Q2'26 ($60.8B vs 58-61) both landed just under the top. Consensus is about $63.25-63.32B. Median is set near $64.0B: the top of the guide plus a trimmed beat, discounted for the last two quarters and the 'light' guidance read. The upper escape above $67B is effectively impossible; below $61B would be an unprecedented miss below the bottom of guidance (~1%). Market check: Kalshi has a Meta company-reports page reportedly with revenue markets, but no price was retrieved; nothing on Polymarket or Manifold.

- Q3 2025 revenue (comparison quarter): about $51.24B. The $61-64B guide implies about 19-25% YoY growth, down from 28% in Q2 and 33% in Q1 2026.
- Q1 2026 (Variety/StockTitan, Apr 2026): revenue $56.3B, +33%, vs consensus $55.45B; Q1 guide was $53.5-56.5B. The Q2 guide given then was $58-61B; actual $60.8B.

- CNBC headline (Jul 29 2026): stock fell on 'light revenue guidance' and shrinking free cash flow.
- Admiral Markets preview (Oct 2026): report expected Oct 28 after close; revenue consensus about $63.25B (another aggregator: $63.32B); Q4 consensus $72-74B; Muse AI agent launched in September, stock up about 27% that month; about $10B legal charge hits GAAP EPS, not revenue.
- Other sources give the report date as Oct 21 or Nov 4; question resolves off the first reported quarterly revenue after Sep 2026 (Q3 2026 total revenue).
- Status quo: revenue lands inside or near the top of the guided range.
- Event window: Q3 2026 (Jul 1-Sep 30) is complete; only reporting remains; about 0% of window uncertainty other than the reported figure.
- Not found: FX move since late July (Fed dot plot reportedly hawkish, possible stronger USD = downside); no Kalshi price retrieved; no channel checks on Q3 ad spending.

calls.reconciliation: Factual disputes: (1) Q2'26 guide range of $58-61B: Run 1 asserted it, Run 3 called it unverified; two runs agree actual was $60.8B, about $0.2B under the top. Accepted as likely, not verified. (2) Report date of Oct 21, 28 or Nov 4: unresolved, but immaterial since the question resolves on Q3 total revenue. The other facts (guide $61-64B, Q3'25 $51.24B, consensus about $63.3B) were consistent across all runs. Judgment: where to centre relative to the $64B top. The beats against guidance are shrinking, while the beats against consensus (+0.9% to +1.5%) point to about $63.9B. I took $63.8B and agree with Run 1's 1% lower escape. The reference class and dispersion basis come from the runs and I agree with them. No web retrieval on this run.
